text:
Mina: dropped a quick pass on the spend table — deciding between a dedicated 'Download' column vs keeping actions in an overflow menu. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/new-spend. Main questions: column density, default scope behavior, and token vs $ presentation.
Carlos: My vote: move heavy actions into overflow to reduce horizontal scroll. Keep a small PDF icon visible for the most common action. On wide screens we can show the full column.
Eve: Agree with overflow-first. Also, default scope should be last-used per user (remembered) and surface a tiny crumb like 'Scope: Project (remembered)'. That reduced confusion in tests.
Sam: For bulk downloads: header action is discoverable on desktop, but mobile testers liked a sticky footer when rows selected. Let's A/B header vs sticky footer and record placement telemetry.
Mina: good — I'll add telemetry keys: `billing.bulk_download.clicked` with `placement:left|right|footer`.
Carlos: Token breakdown chart: do NOT mix tokens and USD on the same axis. Offer a metric toggle or dual-axis with clear color chips. Users got confused when we bundled them.
Eve: Toggle is simplest. If we show both, label with chips: teal = API tokens, indigo = USD. Also format numbers compactly at <600px (e.g., 2.3M) and show full value in tooltip/aria.
Sam: Accessibility: ensure download buttons have `aria-label="Download PDF invoice INV-2024-001"` and overflow menus use role=menu. Focus ring needs to be 3px and visible.
A11yBot: scan: .scope-crumb contrast low; .overflow-menu missing aria-expanded; tooltip-only content not keyboard accessible.
Mina: noted — will bump crumb color, add `aria-expanded` to overflow toggles, and make tooltips keyboard-triggerable.
Carlos: Microcopy: change button text to "Download PDF invoice" everywhere. Offer "Export CSV ledger" as a separate header option. That avoided confusion in support tickets.
Eve: Small UX: when switching scope preserve filters/date range and selected rows to avoid losing context. Also persist denom preference (tokens vs USD) per-user.
Sam: Chart labels: move unit labels inline next to numbers ("4.2M tokens") rather than inside the axis to free up space. Hide inline labels below 480px and rely on hover/focus.
Mina: good call. I'll update the frames: overflow-first with optional full-action column on wide screens, header-left/right + footer variants for bulk, remembered-scope crumb, metric toggle, a11y checklist, and telemetry keys. Expect new frames by tomorrow AM.
Carlos: One tiny nit — ensure legend pills use system radius (6px) and meet 4.5:1 contrast at text sizes.
Eve: +1. Also add `aria-live` announcements for bulk download success/failure: "Downloaded 3 invoices" / "Failed to download 1 invoice".
Sam: sounds good. No blocker from infra.
A11yBot: re-scan pending color token updates.
Mina: thanks all — will iterate and post the updated figma link. :thumbsup:
